settings.quote: In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours.
settings.intro: With hearts full of joy, we invite you to celebrate our engagement.
settings.registryNote: Your presence is the greatest gift. If you wish to honour us with a gift, these details are provided with gratitude.

story.title: The First Encounter
story.description: Under the rain-washed colonnades of Piazza del Duomo, two strangers paused beneath the same olive-green umbrella. A shared sketch and two espressos became the beginning of everything.

story.title: Under the Tuscan Stars
story.description: Between golden hills and long summer evenings, a quiet promise became a beautiful certainty: whatever came next, we would meet it together.

story.title: The Forever Promise
story.description: At the water’s edge, surrounded by the people we love, we chose a lifetime of ordinary mornings, grand adventures, and unwavering devotion.

events.title: Holy Matrimony
events.subtitle: The ceremony
events.description: An intimate gathering and introduction of our extended families
